title: Analyst Memorandum — The Billed Electricity Window behind a Baseline Reset, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Billed Electricity Window behind a Baseline Reset

Memorandum of the analyst group on the window of billed readings gathered when the performance baseline of a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions is restated. A year is 12 months.

## Rule

- Where the tier fixes its baseline over more than twelve months, the billed electricity gathered over the window is the electricity the billed readings of the tier's baseline period recorded, restated as a year.
- Where the tier fixes its baseline over twelve months and the subscription's current term has run twelve whole months or more, it is the electricity those readings recorded in the twelve months ending on the day of the reset.
- Where the tier fixes its baseline over fewer than twelve months, or the subscription's current term has run fewer than twelve whole months, it is the electricity the billed readings of the six months ending on that day recorded, restated as a year.

## Reading the three limbs

| Baseline period fixed for the tier | Whole months the current term has run | Billed electricity gathered |
|---|---|---|
| more than 12 months | any | the billed readings of the tier's baseline period, that total multiplied by 12 and divided by the number of months in that period |
| exactly 12 months | 12 or more | the billed readings of the 12 months ending on the day of the reset, as recorded |
| exactly 12 months | fewer than 12 | the billed readings of the 6 months ending on that day, taken twice |
| fewer than 12 months | any | the billed readings of the 6 months ending on that day, taken twice |

Only readings posted from the utility bills are gathered; each is placed in the window by the day it was posted.

## Cases (hypothetical)

*A tier whose baseline period is 24 months.* The billed readings of that period totalling 2 600 000 kilowatt hours are restated as a year: 2600000 multiplied by 12 and divided by 24, that is 1 300 000 kilowatt hours.

*A tier whose baseline period is 12 months, on a term that has run 15 whole months.* The billed readings of the last 12 months are taken as they stand.

*The same tier on a term that has run 7 whole months.* The billed readings of the last 6 months, totalling 610 000 kilowatt hours, are taken twice: 1 220 000 kilowatt hours.
